exposure: TARGET_EXPOSED; retrospective within-session conditional evaluation; not blind

prior_PR370.scope: read as prior exposure evidence; not merged or executed

external_inspection.method: configured manifest only; 11 accessible external shot copies byte-identical to tracked originals; no corpus rescan
external_inspection.limit: byte identity establishes accepted-copy lineage, not original instrument calibration or independent source custody

observer.clock: native elapsed seconds; no pressure-dependent masking
observer.quadrature: midpoint-cell weights: interior adjacent-time midpoints, outer cells clipped/extended to exact window endpoints; constant endpoint continuation within each window; sums 5 and 28 seconds; no pressure interpolation
observer.volume: piecewise-linear Q, trapezoid from 42; Q alone interpolated at 42 and 75; volume span to exactly 75 used for bounds

units.P: bar machine gauge pressure; absolute level prediction (not thermodynamic absolute pressure)
units.Q: logged showerhead mL/s; not beverage g/s
units.v: mL logged volume; not beverage mass

observer.conditioning: each arm receives measured early P and all selected Q/T; late Q/T conditional replay, not autonomous machine forecast

models.claim: C is a latent response coordinate, not measured TDS, solved solute inventory or viscosity causation
models.TR_domain: Xw 76-90 mass percent; T 295-365 K; industrial extract; dilution Xw>90 and all selected temperatures extrapolated; not validated water viscosity

fit.split: 11 leave-one-physical-shot-out; every copy excluded from training
fit.objective: equally physical-shot weighted time-weighted later pressure MSE; bootstrap multiplicity weights

bounds.L: [0.1,10] * median training 42-75 logged-volume span; median includes bootstrap multiplicity

fit.transform: affine map a and logL rectangle to [0,1]^2
fit.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, analytic cost+gradient, max 200 objective evaluations/start enforced; maxiter 200, maxls 20, ftol 1e-11, gtol 1e-7
fit.fixed: ST<0.01 fixes corresponding transformed coordinate at 0.5; remaining dimensions reported; nine starts retained even if duplicates; all starts/cost/boundaries/convergence retained privately
fit.initialization: no all-data fit, no warm starts or fitted-parameter cache

gsa.design: Sobol/Saltelli scrambled, independent uniform a and logL bounds, base N=512, no second order
gsa.ci: 95% percentile, saltelli-jansen; no thresholding of CIs; wide/near-threshold remains uncertain
gsa.bootstrap_policy: recompute training-only ST with multiplicity in every bootstrap training fit, same design and 200 sensitivity bootstraps; cache only per-shot design losses, never fitted optima

secondary: normalized apparent-resistance RMSE: ((P_hat-P)/Q) divided by N anchor least-squares amplitude; Q>0 on evaluation window

bootstrap.unit: physical shot identities sampled with replacement, n=11; retain counts; evaluate each included identity with own early anchor, exclude all its copies in training; average test MSE weighted by counts; refit both arms
bootstrap.ci: paired 2.5/97.5 percentiles; invalid replicates explicit; no time-sample bootstrap; conditional same-session exchangeability, no systematic sensor error

score.boundary_sensitivity: all 9 independent products of lower/upper boundary multipliers [0.75,1,1.25], same predictions; report all bands intersected by CIs
score.influence: leave-one-identity-out reduction of fixed OOF losses plus per-shot paired MSE; descriptive, no outlier deletion

sensitivity_rule: Q*=1+drift*(t-42)/33 for 42..75; rebuild volume/anchor/prediction; refit training, rescreen identically; no new CIs or model search

numerics.reference: same nine starts/bounds/screening; tighter ftol 1e-14, gtol 1e-10 and max 200 evaluations/start; independent math.fsum score reduction on all primary OOF arrays
numerics.clock: entire scientific execution including GSA, bootstrap, sensitivities and reference; wall clock
numerics.failure: retain completed checkpoint; missing CIs unresolved, never zero

decision: resolved V advantage over B and N retains V for conditional prediction; resolved disadvantage retains better simpler comparator; zero-spanning gain intervals unresolved; no external practical-adequacy margin; no viscosity causation/permeability/latent chemistry/EWP/P1 claim
delivery: one implementation, one independent scientific review, at most one material correction; draft PR unmerged auto-merge disabled; detailed traces/fit logs/bootstrap/private source receipts outside Git

pre_fit_amendment.reason: 20210302T111600 has Q=0 at two anchor samples (42.121,42.299 s); all evaluation Q positive and anchor sum(w*Q^2)>0
pre_fit_amendment.change: secondary normalization uses finite anchor N amplitude instead of mean(P/Q); retain all native samples; no primary/model/fit changes
pre_fit_amendment.timing: before any optimization/GSA/score; only direct objective/gradient smoke call attempted and blocked at input validation
